summary: Complete fractional poussette and figure-eight paths
produces: Implement the deferred quarter-family paths for poussette and figure_8 with explicit intermediate occupancy instead of reducing them to half or full permutations.

conditions: Quarter and three-quarter paths are collision-free and reversible where required.
figure_8 across is either proven as a real permutation or remains explicitly rejected as degenerate.
Existing half and full behavior remains unchanged.
